description.zh:
是否强制删除快照。

默认值：false。
description.en:
Specifies whether to force delete the snapshot.

Default value: false.

description.zh: DBFS实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the DBFS instance. Call [DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html) to view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

description.zh:
快照ID或者快照ID列表。
- 删除单个快照时输入快照ID
- 批量删除时以JSON数组形式输入快照ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开，一次最多指定100个快照ID。
description.en:
The ID of the snapshot or a list of snapshot IDs.

- To delete a single snapshot, enter the snapshot ID.

- For batch deletion, enter the snapshot IDs as a JSON array. Separate the IDs with commas (,). You can specify up to 100 snapshot IDs at a time.

descriptions.zh:
调用该接口时，您需要注意：

- 如果指定的快照ID不存在，请求将被忽略。

- 如果存在使用该快照创建的dbfs则不允许删除，强制删除需传入参数Force为true。
descriptions.en:
Note:

- If the specified snapshot ID does not exist, the request is ignored.

- You cannot delete a snapshot if a DBFS instance was created from it. To force delete the snapshot, set the Force parameter to true.
